items.title: Announcing OpenAI Grove Cohort 2
items.summary: Applications are now open for OpenAI Grove Cohort 2, a 5-week founder program designed for individuals at any stage, from pre-idea to product. Participants receive $50K in API credits, early access to AI tools, and hands-on mentorship from the OpenAI team.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI启动了Grove Cohort 2创业孵化项目，为初创团队提供API额度与导师指导。该项目旨在支持AI生态建设，而非模型技术层面的更新。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于企业孵化项目招募，与模型技术研发无直接关联。
